step_ids.label: Step IDs
step_ids.tooltip: How the sheet writes its step IDs and section rows.

classic.label: A01.)  +  named steps (SETUP)
classic.tooltip: IDs like A01.); a bare word (SETUP) is a step; sections are SECTION X: Title rows.

numbered.label: A01 / IN_01 / B03.5  +  INTRO banners
numbered.tooltip: IDs like A01, IN_01 or B03.5 (A01.) still reads); INTRO and OUTRO rows start a section. B03.5 becomes the shot B03_5.

behaviors.label: Behaviors
behaviors.tooltip: Where each row's behaviors come from.

description.label: From the description
description.tooltip: Phrases in the row's text that a behavior template detects ("fades in").

column.label: From the Behaviors column
column.tooltip: Names or phrases listed in the Behaviors column, one row at a time.

column_else_description.label: Column, else description
column_else_description.tooltip: The Behaviors column where a row fills it, else the row's text.

objects.label: Objects
objects.tooltip: Where each step's objects come from.

column_else_description.label: Asset column, else the description
column_else_description.tooltip: A step whose asset cells are empty lists what its text names by a behavior ("Highlight Red Door" -> Red_Door, highlighted).

column.label: Asset column only
column.tooltip: Only names in the asset column; Auto-fill Missing Assets can take the rest from the scene.

object_case.label: Object Case
object_case.tooltip: Case of the object names read from the description (StrUtils.set_case).

object_name_rule.label: Object Names
object_name_rule.tooltip: How the object names read from the description are made legal (StrUtils.apply_name_rule).

legal.label: Legal (Red_Door)
legal.tooltip: Every non-alphanumeric becomes _, one for one -- the Maya and Qt name rule.

sanitized.label: Sanitized (Red_Door)
sanitized.tooltip: Each run of non-alphanumerics becomes one _, trailing ones dropped.

filename.label: File-safe (Red Door)
filename.tooltip: Only characters no file name may hold are removed; spaces stay.

keep.label: As written (Red Door)
keep.tooltip: The text as the doc spells it.

match.label: Match Shots
match.tooltip: How a step finds its shot in the scene. A build records the pairing on the shot, so later doc edits never shift it.

name.label: By name
name.tooltip: The shot named after the step (or already bound to it).

name_then_order.label: By name, then order
name_then_order.tooltip: Then the remaining steps and shots in timeline order -- for a scene whose shots were named before the doc.

audio.label: Audio
audio.tooltip: Whether each step's voice text names an audio clip to key.

text.label: Voice text only
text.tooltip: The voice column is narration text; no clip is keyed.

derive.label: Derive clip names
derive.tooltip: Each step keys a clip named from its step ID and the first 3 words of its voice text.

fill_missing_assets.label: Auto-fill Missing Assets
fill_missing_assets.tooltip: Steps the sheet lists no assets for take what their paired shot holds: its members and what animates in its range (no shot, no names -- Build first). Copy Asset Names writes them back to the sheet.
